primary_metric_status: explicit_first_planning_attempt_time; admission-based paper/network values are diagnostic

user_tht.definition: Primary user THT: per original business sum of each leg continuous finish minus first_planning_attempt_time. Includes every planning retry, device passage and internal wait; excludes EBS inter-leg storage and preplanning hold. No fallback for missing first-attempt telemetry.

paper_tht.definition: Network-elapsed component: per business sum of each leg continuous finish minus successful actual admission. Includes device passage and internal wait, excludes planning retries and EBS dwell. Legacy paper_tht field is not the user THT objective.

network_elapsed.definition: Network-elapsed component: per business sum of each leg continuous finish minus successful actual admission. Includes device passage and internal wait, excludes planning retries and EBS dwell. Legacy paper_tht field is not the user THT objective.

segment_canonical_elapsed.definition: Continuous finish minus canonical pass_time for each independent transport leg; includes every hold before actual admission.

business_sum_canonical_elapsed.definition: Sum of leg canonical elapsed per original business bag; excludes the interval between inbound finish and nominal outbound release.

segment_network_duration.definition: Continuous finish minus actual admission per independent leg.

segment_source_hold.definition: Canonical-to-admission component: actual admission minus canonical pass_time. Includes preplanning hold and planning retries; not wholly outside-system waiting. Canonical pass_time is not actual source-generation time.

business_sum_source_hold.definition: Sum of leg canonical source hold per original business bag.

business_end_to_end.definition: Final leg continuous finish minus original_entry_time; includes EBS dwell and all external holds. Requires all legs complete.

business_first_admission_to_final_goal.definition: Final leg continuous finish minus actual admission of the first leg (storage_in or direct); includes EBS dwell, excludes initial external hold. Requires all legs complete.

interpretation: Full-population duration statistics are null whenever any member lacks the required completed observation; completed-subset values are diagnostic only.
Canonical-to-admission observations become known at actual admission even if transport is incomplete; they include both preplanning hold and retries.
User THT requires explicit first_planning_attempt_time. A source activation, generated_release, successful admission or canonical release never fills a missing anchor.

Restricted elapsed is finish-release for completed legs, otherwise max(0,horizon-release). Restricted network is finish-admission or observed in-network exposure; unadmitted legs contribute zero exposure, not zero eventual THT.
Missing telemetry preserves denominators and invalidates source/network exposure split. Restricted canonical elapsed conservatively treats missing records as uncompleted through horizon.
Observed ceil finish is an auxiliary common transformation; continuous physical finish defines the primary result.
Metric validity does not establish physical safety, EBS causality, optimality, or a performance advantage. These require independent audits.
Unlaunched reserved certificates remain unadmitted and censored. First-attempt-to-horizon exposure includes the future-reservation hold; planned clocks never substitute for actual clocks.

future_reservation_audit.boundary: Initial reserved certificate is persistent provenance. Pending plans are not actual admissions, routes, finishes or completed observations.

business.cutoff_count_method: All transport legs completed; final actual goal arrival at or before the common original cutoff. Derived from this run, not a separate short execution.

conflict_diagnostics.interpretation: Repeated failed exact resource queries, not unique bags or a causal delay decomposition; local ranking probes excluded

native.run_cpu_measurement: Windows GetProcessTimes kernel+user; std::clock on non-Windows; event loop only

contract.planner: local lookahead ordered neighbour DFS with atomic full continuation certificate
contract.safety_information_range: may extend to goal, independently of observation depth
contract.source_route_budget_relaxation: Only on actual source attempts: base excess + rate * age since immutable first planning attempt; growth floors to integer microseconds. No new wake event; an existing calendar jump may skip an earlier newly permitted detour. No earliest-feasible or monotone THT guarantee; in-route finish-nonincreasing fallback policy unchanged.
contract.static_rank_fastpath: At requested depth1 and zero congestion weight, return static H without calendar probes; logical score-budget consumption/exhaustion and choice order preserved; actual query depth/count zero.
contract.rolling_policy: at each physical internal arrival rank neighbours; a single choice or unchanged best keeps fallback; strictly better next attempts exact suffix exchange, finish cannot become later; failure retains all rights
contract.rolling_event_order: at equal time: physical arrival or reserved source launch by event serial, resource cleanup, source release, source attempt, EBS activation; ledger_order is global
contract.rolling_ebs_gate: release depends on actual predecessor goal event and latest route generation, never a stale predicted completion
contract.timing_clocks: activation_time records first entry into the external source FIFO; first_planning_attempt_time records first actual head-eligible planning attempt and never resets on failure; admission is successful physical network entry
contract.primary_tht_clock: sum per original business bag of each leg actual goal arrival minus first_planning_attempt_time; source preplanning hold and canonical elapsed are mandatory companion measures
contract.interval_conflict: half-open intervals on integer microsecond grid; touching endpoints allowed; zero-service points occupy no resource
contract.source_endpoint: positive-service source checked and reserved before external admission
contract.goal_endpoint: finish at arrival; positive-service goal checked and resource retained through departure
contract.edge_resource: directed-edge entry interval only, not whole-edge unit capacity; all endpoint and zero-connector flows included
contract.resource_cleanup: ceil_q(max(business completion epoch, strict goal reservation end, all edge entry window ends)); business finish remains goal arrival
contract.failed_search_transaction: read-only; no reservation is inserted before a complete route exists
contract.retry_bound_scope: explored prefixes only; budget truncation can skip an earlier feasible alternative
contract.logical_messages: simulation counts, no network latency or real distributed concurrency model
contract.global_static_preprocessing: one service-aware reverse Dijkstra per distinct goal; topology only
contract.score_budget_scope: max_score_expansions per current-node local ranking; max_expansions per full DFS attempt
contract.congestion_signal: unchanged exact-window blocking delay proxy plus original 30-second node union occupancy multiplied by 2/30; only ranking changes
contract.occupancy_risk_price_boundary: 2*rho is a bounded occupancy risk-price heuristic, not expected queue waiting, a future source waiting prediction, whole-route capacity or a throughput guarantee. Fixed spatial k, physical certificates, FIFO, source clocks and budgets are unchanged. Zero-service node pressure remains zero.
contract.source_generation: precomputed eligibility uses stable nominal order and source interval; source_fifo additionally paces successful admissions by that interval; no early release; not an exact reproduction of Java generation/comparator quirks
contract.canonical_source_order: when explicitly enabled: stable original nominal release order, input row order for ties; an unreleased or predecessor-blocked head blocks every later source item, activation does not append/reorder
contract.future_source_policy: After failed immediate DFS before first static branch, and minimum immutable-first-attempt age: intersect integer launch mask along one static shortest chain. All positive node and directed-edge entry rights are atomically precommitted. Earliest only for this chain/current snapshot, not all paths. Window independent of observation end. Additional route allowance freezes at actual attempt, not future launch.
contract.future_source_lifecycle: source_reserve is not physical admission; source_launch consumes the same IDs at planned_admission, then advances canonical FIFO and schedules physical arrivals/cleanup. EBS remains gated by actual goal arrival. Failed immediate DFS still counts failed_attempts even if future rescue succeeds; launch is not another planning attempt.
contract.future_source_measurement: Fixed-chain construction, calendar-entry scanning and exact validation are included in existing source decision wall samples (goal-table lookup through reservation/dispatch, not pure DFS). Wall sums reuse existing samples without new clock calls. Separate queries/scanned counters expose extra work, not measured protocol messages. Future chain route_decisions requested_k=0 records no local rank query; committed_route_hop_k_histogram retains original immediate-DFS scope. No real network timing or global throughput guarantee.
